summary.name: SeaArt AI
summary.one_liner: SeaArt AI is an online AI creativity community for generating images, videos, audio and AI chats, with templates, models and sharing.
use_cases: remix and share artwork with a community
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SeaArt AI as an all-in-one creativity community covering images, videos, audio and AI chats. It advertises text-to-image and image-to-image generation with templates, one-click effects and a range of ready-to-use models. For video, it mentions multimodal control over text, image, video and audio inputs, native stereo 2K video up to 15 seconds, and native audio sync. The FAQ section indicates it has a public community gallery, tutorials, and questions about model training and private creations, though the answers are not included in the page text.
notable: Multimodal video creation with native audio sync and up to 15s stereo 2K output
Large library of ready-to-use models, templates and one-click effects
Community gallery for remixing and sharing creations
caveats: Pricing tiers and free-usage limits are not detailed on the page text
Mobile app availability is only posed as an FAQ question, not confirmed on the page
